def _existing_order_with_membership(event, customer, membership, item, code='MEM1', status=Order.STATUS_PAID):
    order = Order.objects.create(
        event=event, code=code, status=status, email='dummy@example.org', datetime=now(),
        expires=now() + timedelta(days=10), total=Decimal('23.00'), customer=customer,
    )
    OrderPosition.objects.create(
        order=order, item=item, price=Decimal('23.00'), positionid=1, used_membership=membership,
    )
    return order


@pytest.mark.django_db
def test_validate_memberships_no_membership_required(event, customer):
    item = Item.objects.create(event=event, name='Ticket', default_price=Decimal('23.00'), admission=True)
    validate_memberships_in_order(None, [CartPosition(event=event, item=item, price=23)], event)
    validate_memberships_in_order(customer, [CartPosition(event=event, item=item, price=23)], event)


@pytest.mark.django_db
def test_validate_memberships_missing(event, customer, requiring_ticket):
    cp = CartPosition(event=event, item=requiring_ticket, price=23)
    with pytest.raises(ValidationError) as excinfo:
        validate_memberships_in_order(customer, [cp], event)
    assert 'membership' in excinfo.value.message


@pytest.mark.django_db
def test_validate_memberships_without_customer(event, requiring_ticket, membership):
    cp = CartPosition(event=event, item=requiring_ticket, price=23, used_membership=membership)
    with pytest.raises(ValidationError) as excinfo:
        validate_memberships_in_order(None, [cp], event)
    assert 'membership' in excinfo.value.message


@pytest.mark.django_db
def test_validate_memberships_of_other_customer(event, customer, membership, requiring_ticket):
    other = event.organizer.customers.create(email="jane@example.org")
    other_membership = other.memberships.create(
        membership_type=membership.membership_type,
        date_start=membership.date_start,
        date_end=membership.date_end,
    )
    cp = CartPosition(event=event, item=requiring_ticket, price=23, used_membership=other_membership)
    with pytest.raises(ValidationError):
        validate_memberships_in_order(customer, [cp], event)


@pytest.mark.django_db
def test_validate_memberships_type_not_allowed(event, customer, membership, requiring_ticket):
    other_type = event.organizer.membership_types.create(name="Other")
    m = customer.memberships.create(
        membership_type=other_type,
        date_start=membership.date_start,
        date_end=membership.date_end,
    )
    cp = CartPosition(event=event, item=requiring_ticket, price=23, used_membership=m)
    with pytest.raises(ValidationError):
        validate_memberships_in_order(customer, [cp], event)


@pytest.mark.django_db
def test_validate_memberships_canceled(event, customer, membership, requiring_ticket):
    membership.canceled = True
    membership.save()
    cp = CartPosition(event=event, item=requiring_ticket, price=23, used_membership=membership)
    with pytest.raises(ValidationError):
        validate_memberships_in_order(customer, [cp], event)


@pytest.mark.django_db
def test_validate_memberships_testmode(event, customer, membership, requiring_ticket):
    cp = CartPosition(event=event, item=requiring_ticket, price=23, used_membership=membership)
    with pytest.raises(ValidationError):
        validate_memberships_in_order(customer, [cp], event, testmode=True)
    validate_memberships_in_order(customer, [cp], event, testmode=False)


@pytest.mark.django_db
def test_validate_memberships_not_valid_for_event(event, customer, membership, requiring_ticket):
    membership.date_start -= timedelta(days=100)
    membership.date_end -= timedelta(days=100)
    membership.save()
    cp = CartPosition(event=event, item=requiring_ticket, price=23, used_membership=membership)
    with pytest.raises(ValidationError):
        validate_memberships_in_order(customer, [cp], event)


@pytest.mark.django_db
def test_validate_memberships_valid_from_not_chosen(event, customer, membership, requiring_ticket):
    membership.date_start = now() + timedelta(days=10)
    membership.date_end = now() + timedelta(days=100)
    membership.save()
    cp = CartPosition(event=event, item=requiring_ticket, price=23, used_membership=membership)
    with pytest.raises(ValidationError):
        validate_memberships_in_order(customer, [cp], event)
    validate_memberships_in_order(customer, [cp], event, valid_from_not_chosen=True)


@pytest.mark.django_db
def test_validate_memberships_max_usages_by_existing_order(event, customer, membership, requiring_ticket):
    membership.membership_type.max_usages = 1
    membership.membership_type.save()
    order = _existing_order_with_membership(event, customer, membership, requiring_ticket)
    cp = CartPosition(event=event, item=requiring_ticket, price=23, used_membership=membership)
    with pytest.raises(ValidationError):
        validate_memberships_in_order(customer, [cp], event)
    # The order being changed does not count against its own membership
    validate_memberships_in_order(customer, [cp], event, ignored_order=order)


@pytest.mark.django_db
def test_validate_memberships_max_usages_within_purchase(event, customer, membership, requiring_ticket):
    membership.membership_type.max_usages = 1
    membership.membership_type.save()
    membership.membership_type.allow_parallel_usage = True
    membership.membership_type.save()
    cp1 = CartPosition(event=event, item=requiring_ticket, price=23, used_membership=membership)
    cp2 = CartPosition(event=event, item=requiring_ticket, price=23, used_membership=membership)
    with pytest.raises(ValidationError):
        validate_memberships_in_order(customer, [cp1, cp2], event)


@pytest.mark.django_db
def test_validate_memberships_parallel_usage(event, customer, membership, requiring_ticket):
    order = _existing_order_with_membership(event, customer, membership, requiring_ticket)
    cp = CartPosition(event=event, item=requiring_ticket, price=23, used_membership=membership)
    with pytest.raises(ValidationError):
        validate_memberships_in_order(customer, [cp], event)
    validate_memberships_in_order(customer, [cp], event, ignored_order=order)

    membership.membership_type.allow_parallel_usage = True
    membership.membership_type.save()
    validate_memberships_in_order(customer, [cp], event)


@pytest.mark.django_db
def test_validate_memberships_parallel_usage_within_purchase(event, customer, membership, requiring_ticket):
    cp1 = CartPosition(event=event, item=requiring_ticket, price=23, used_membership=membership)
    cp2 = CartPosition(event=event, item=requiring_ticket, price=23, used_membership=membership)
    with pytest.raises(ValidationError):
        validate_memberships_in_order(customer, [cp1, cp2], event)


@pytest.mark.django_db
def test_validate_memberships_lock(event, customer, membership, requiring_ticket):
    cp = CartPosition(event=event, item=requiring_ticket, price=23, used_membership=membership)
    with transaction.atomic():
        validate_memberships_in_order(customer, [cp], event, lock=True)
EOF
